thread:
Olivia: Heads-up — I'm reorganizing the Quickstart welcome deck and want to collapse the scattered auth/snippet examples into a single "Welcome Snippets" partial. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 Please shout if this would break any onboarding sequences.

Maya: @Olivia looks good. main question: do we still keep language-specific auth snippets inline or reference per-SDK files?

Olivia: plan is to surface a single cross-language flow in the deck and link to SDK-specific pages for details. That reduces duplication.

Samir: two concerns: 1) starter app deploy step uses the old env var name REDWOOD_API_KEY in code samples, we switched to RW_API_KEY in SDK7. Need a sweep. 2) the Docker quickstart has a one-liner that won’t work with tokenless local mode.

Maya: I'll run grep and make PR for env var renames. Samir — can you paste the failing WSL/docker line?

Samir: ```
docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=... -p 3000:3000 starter:latest
``` -> should be `-e RW_API_KEY=...` Also add note about `--network=host` for WSL.

Lee: I'll update the Quickstart step to call out SDK-specific tokens + include snippet for `export RW_API_KEY=...` and a short note about Windows cmd vs PowerShell.

Aj: tiny nit — welcome deck intro uses "deploy to production in 5 minutes" which is aspirational. Suggest change to "deploy a prototype quickly" :)

docs-bot: checklist created: docs-pr #842 linked, env-var sweep assigned to Maya, docker note assigned to Samir.

Olivia: great, thanks. Maya/Samir/Lee - can we aim to merge these patches before Monday so the onboarding lab isn't out of sync? :thumbsup: 

Maya: yes, I can take it; will open PRs today.

Samir: will add docker caveat and fix snippet by EOD.

Lee: will update deck copy and retest on Windows this afternoon.

Olivia: perfect — leaving this here. /cc @Aj for copy review.
